verdicts.reason: Both are crude crops of the photo. The cream jar is cut off at the right edge, the dropper bottles and capsules are gone, and 'Spa' sits on the edge of the glass dish. The beige brush-stroke panel is pulled up and away from the title, so it floats as a meaningless blob instead of backing the text. Both leave a dead band at the bottom. A's stroke keeps the original shape and sits slightly closer to the title. B's stroke looks warped and rotated, and it is pushed even higher, so it is more detached from the text.
